Title: Microsoft Power Fx: The open-source low-code programming language is in public preview

Body.Content:
This formula-based language originates from Microsoft Excel and is already the foundation of the Microsoft Power Apps canvas. Professional developers can reduce development costs and time with the following capabilities.

Integration with Azure services: Power Fx can leverage the capabilities of tools such as Visual Studio Code, GitHub, and Azure DevOps. Developers won’t change the development process; they will just use the low-code language to build faster.

Custom connector integration: Power Fx can build custom logic that combine with custom API connectors created in JavaScript, C#, or other professional languages.

Guardrails: Dataverse entities and data types are first class objects, and guardrails prevent run away code and other common pitfalls.

Learn more.
